title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Client Tunnel Work Item
summary: Add an HTTP/3 client helper that opens an RFC 9220 WebSocket Extended CONNECT tunnel and exposes masked client-to-server WebSocket message IO.
planned_changes:
- Add `Http3Client.OpenWebSocketAsync` for RFC 9220 WebSocket Extended CONNECT requests.
- Add `Http3WebSocketClientTunnelContext` for client-side WebSocket message reads, masked writes, ping/pong, and close helpers.
- Add local HTTP/3 QUIC loopback tests for successful client tunnel echo and the required local `SETTINGS_ENABLE_CONNECT_PROTOCOL` guard.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 WebSocket client tunnel tests, adjacent WebSocket regression tests, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Production proxy target, timeout, or authorization policy.
QUIC transport runtime, ACK, recovery, pacing, or packet-protection changes.
completion_notes: The HTTP/3 client can now open a local RFC 9220 WebSocket tunnel, send masked client frames, receive unmasked server frames, and expose the accepted tunnel response headers without waiting for stream FIN.
